transcript_tail.text:
Title set to `[AH.mini] Automate Claude session preservation on launchd reset`. The reason the auto-template skipped `.mini` is because this is an SDK desktop session — `env_kind=bridge` but no local `bridge-cse_*/` worktree, so `is_host_local()` returns false. Worth a follow-up fix in `_run_set` (could fall back to hostname match for bridge sessions with no worktree), but I'll move on.

Now for the resume — I need to clarify how. Bare `claude -r <id>` is interactive (would block in this terminal) and headless `claude -p` would just answer one prompt and exit. Three plausible interpretations:
Pivoting — the user wants a scripted solution. Let me survey what's already there for resume + supervisor restart.

Survey done. Here's the integrated script-solution shape, with what each piece touches:

```
scripts/supervisor-restart.sh    ← NEW user-facing entry point
  1. snapshot mm-* server cse_ids on THIS host (parse logs/mm-*.log)
  2. launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.claudio1.claude-remote-control
  3. poll logs until all wanted servers spawn a fresh cse_ (new id != snapshot)
  4. python3 -m remote_control fork-all --host <nick> --ids <orphans>
  5. (optional --archive) archive each source after its fork succeeds
  6. (optional --open) `open -na Terminal --args claude -r <uuid>` per fork

remote_control/session_fork_all.py    ← NEW bulk subcommand (task #3)
  Reused by step 4 above AND callable standalone.

remote_control/usage_limit/monitor.py + sessions archive subcommand  ← task #9
  archive_session(cfg, token, sid, log) → POST/PATCH probe.
  python3 -m remote_control sessions archive cse_…  (utility)

skills/remote-control-dirs/SKILL.md  ← EDIT
  "Reload now" section: replace bare `launchctl kickstart -k …`
  with `scripts/supervisor-restart.sh` and document the snapshot/fork/archive flow.
  Add a "Don't" item: don't bare-kickstart — you'll orphan disconnected cse_s.
```

What the `claude://` probe found: **no session-open route in the app** (only `claude://claude.ai/mcp-auth-callback/sdk` and `claude://cowork/shared-artifact?uuid=…`). So step 6 of "open in the desktop app" isn't really possible today — fallback is `open -na Terminal` per fork, or you alt-tab to the app and pick the session from `/resume` since the jsonl is already on disk. I'd default the script to **NOT** auto-open (just print the resume commands) and offer `--open-terminal` for those who want the terminal flow.

Two confirmations before I build:

Quick reality check on "trigger sessions that show in Claude Code desktop":

- **The forks are already on disk** at `~/.claude/projects/-Users-claudio1-dev-ai-harness/<uuid>.jsonl`. Opening Claude.app at that cwd and using **/resume** will list them in the picker. So they ARE "in the app" — just not cloud-registered as `cse_` ids in the cross-host session list.
- To make them appear as **`cse_`** sessions in the unified session list (the one we've been looking at), each would need to be re-launched under `claude remote-control` (which mints a fresh `cse_`). It's plausible that `claude --remote-control --resume <uuid>` would register-and-resume in one step, but I haven't verified — would need to test on one of the 5.
- There's no `claude://` URL route to "open session X" in the desktop app (I checked the bundle).

So the practical "trigger from script" choice is:

**Probe result: doesn't work.** `claude --remote-control --resume <local-uuid>` errors with *"No deferred tool marker found in the resumed session"* — that flag combo is for resuming a remote-control session that paused on a deferred tool, not for promoting a local uuid into a fresh `cse_`. Adding `-p "READY"` got the prompt to run (printed READY and exited) but **no new `cse_` appeared** in the session list. The forks stay local-only.

Also noticed: the `[AH.mini]` title I set on `cse_0164WQ…` was reverted to `[AH]` (the SDK must be writing back the auto-template). The host-suffix problem for SDK desktop sessions is structural, not just one-shot — saved as feedback.

So the design has to accept that the **forks can't appear as `cse_` in the unified list**. Realistic trigger options for the script:

Honest answer: "create a session and push content to it" would need APIs I don't know exist. Two pieces missing:

1. **Create-session endpoint** — we only know `GET /sessions`, `GET /sessions/{id}`, `POST /sessions/{id}/resume`, and `PUT title` (used by `set_title`). No confirmed `POST /sessions` to mint a fresh `cse_`, and no confirmed "append turns" endpoint.
2. **Bulk-inject transcript** — even if (1) exists, pushing 400–660 lines of historical user/assistant/tool turns into a freshly-created session is almost certainly not a public operation; the session expects to grow turn-by-turn through the SDK.

What IS true about the forks today:
- They're in `~/.claude/projects/-Users-claudio1-dev-ai-harness/` already
- The desktop app's **local** /resume picker reads from that dir → forks already show up there
- Going from "local uuid" → "`cse_` in the unified session list" is the missing step, and I haven't found a path
